verdict.rationale: Canny documents a changelog for announcing shipped features and SDK user identification with custom fields and company data. No evidence shows that changelog announcements can be segmented or targeted by user attributes, and the user-identification data is documented only for tying feedback to accounts. The axis applies to a changelog product, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can segment product release announcements by user attributes to send targeted release notes
